original_metadata.title: The Moonshine vertex operator algebra has a unique self-dual Monster-invariant integral form compatible with the specified two-prime cyclotomic orbifold forms
original_metadata.author: Scott Carnahan
original_metadata.source_title: A Self-Dual Integral Form of the Moonshine Module
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The construction must produce integral homogeneous lattices with a perfect invariant form while retaining the entire Monster action, rather than merely taking an arbitrary integral span in the complex module. The author builds self-dual forms inside cyclic orbifolds, compares them through pure elementary abelian subgroups, and descends compatible cyclotomic localizations to an integral form. The uniqueness argument also tracks every prescribed two-prime base change, including the distinct prime-13 cases.

proof_review.note: The complete Theorem3.22 proof and its essential new construction chain were read: the self-dual abelian-intertwining form engine (2.35–2.41), Leech-lattice lift and centralizer calculations (2.44–2.48), the simultaneous two-prime orbifold forms and Monster invariance (3.1–3.12), compatibility using pure elementary abelian Monster subgroups (3.13–3.15), and the cyclotomic/localization descent and uniqueness gluing (3.17–3.22). The new form engine explicitly supplies spanning, injectivity, invariant-form integrality and self-duality arguments; the final proof includes the separate prime-13 compatibility. Established complex cyclic-orbifold theorems, Leech integral forms, Monster subgroup facts and standard faithfully flat module descent are cited background. Select only the specified compatible integral form, not uniqueness among all conceivable integral forms or the positive-definiteness and Griess corollaries.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Exactly Theorem3.22: V^natural is the complex Moonshine vertex operator algebra; P_0={2,3,5,7,13}; the specified V^natural[1/pq,e(1/2pq)] are the self-dual cyclotomic two-prime forms constructed earlier in this paper. There exists a self-dual Z-form whose extension to Z[1/pq,e(1/2pq)] is isomorphic to that specified form for every distinct p,q in P_0 with pq not in {65,91}; it is unique up to isomorphism subject to these compatibilities and has Monster symmetry. Self-dual means its finite projective homogeneous pieces pair perfectly under the invariant form. No claim of unrestricted uniqueness of all integral forms, nor a separate positivity or Griess-algebra result, is selected.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: The packet selects the concrete cyclotomic S-integer and integer-ring construction. General arbitrary-ring gluing statements in Section2 are not separate selected assertions; the author explicitly applies their descent machinery to these specified rings in Section3. Proposition2.48(2) credits the earlier homogeneous-automorphism proof [8, Proposition2.5.2] with minimal change; this provenance is retained rather than silently presented as a new fully expanded independent proof.
